title: Longest Stretch Without Repeats
statement: A sensor writes one character per second. Find the length of the longest contiguous stretch of the record in which no character appears twice.
input_format: One line with the record (printable ASCII characters without spaces).
output_format: Print the length of the longest stretch with all characters distinct.

examples.explanation: abc is the longest stretch without a repeat, so the answer is 3.

hints: Think of a window over the record that you grow on the right.
When the new character already appears inside the window, move the left edge past its previous position.
Remember the last position of each character so each step is constant time.
